name.en: Junction box family, IP68, three bypass diodes (split and single-diode reference)
name.es: Familia de caja de conexiones, IP68, tres diodos de bypass (referencia partida y de un diodo)

description.en: Junction box as printed in the module datasheets: IP68 with three bypass diodes (LONGi LR8-66HVD, LR5-54HTB; AIKO; Canadian Solar CS6.2-54TM; Heliene G12R 35 mm). Renew (S21) and JinkoSolar (S18) print IP68 without diode count. Split 3-part construction, box dimensions and diode ratings were not found in any source reached; a single-diode box from Hirschmann is included as a reference only.
description.es: Caja de conexiones segun las fichas de modulos: IP68 con tres diodos de bypass (LONGi LR8-66HVD y LR5-54HTB; AIKO; Canadian Solar CS6.2-54TM; Heliene G12R de 35 mm). Renew (S21) y JinkoSolar (S18) imprimen IP68 sin numero de diodos. No se hallaron en ninguna fuente consultada la construccion partida en tres partes, las dimensiones de la caja ni las caracteristicas de los diodos; se incluye una caja de un solo diodo de Hirschmann solo como referencia.

unverified_items: Split 3-part construction, dimensions, and diode ratings (current, voltage, type) are not_found.
Renhe, Amphenol, Zhejiang Qunli and Staubli junction box datasheets were searched; no product datasheet with dimensions was reached.
Diode count printed as 3 in S1, S3, S5, S17, S19, S20 and S22; not printed in S2, S18 and S21.
Single-diode reference box is not a module box for three-diode modules.
